title: See actionable coverage gaps without a product verdict
statement: As a change author, I can see separate, actionable gaps for each documentation area, so that I can improve the Saga without a tool deciding whether the change may ship.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The report shows covered and uncovered entries separately for each supported area.
A report with coverage gaps is still produced successfully.
The report fails when it cannot evaluate the Saga reliably.
The machine-readable report uses a stable documented shape.
The report is readable without processing machine-readable output.
The report presents next actions in a stable priority order.
Each next action offers one command or asks one focused question.
